# Summarise a generated batch for operator review

Summarise the most recent batch for the named feature:

- Cases generated, by test type
- Cases rejected, by reason
- Automatability split, with the reason for anything manual-only
- Anything you could not determine and recorded as a gap

Keep it short enough to read in a minute. The operator is deciding whether to
approve, not reading a report for its own sake.

State the derivation of the count. "40 cases" means little; "40 cases from 12
coverage items, ISTQB-standard depth" can be checked.
